node: Thermal management and power-conditioning components for high-density AI racks
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the thermal and power-conditioning component node found one reference anchor and three supplier/component candidates. The strongest mapped underfollowed lanes are: nVent for liquid-cooling plus rack/row power distribution, Vicor for high-density 48V/data-center power modules, and Bel Fuse for lower-profile power, protection, magnetics, and connectivity products used in networking and data-center systems. Vertiv remains the obvious reference integrator, useful for context but less aligned with the underfollowed mandate. The bottleneck hypothesis remains plausible: as AI rack density rises, qualification-sensitive components such as CDUs, manifolds, PDUs, busway, power converters, magnetics, connectors, and leak/thermal control subsystems may become the harder-to-replace layer beneath branded infrastructure integrators.
